{{Top}}
[[File:Class_One_lineup.png|thumb|300px|A lineup of first-degree droids]]
A '''class one''' or '''first-degree droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] for the mathematical, medical, or physical sciences. Subcategories of the first degree included [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], biological science droids, physical science droids, and mathematics droids.<ref name="Droids and Machines">{{WebCite|url=http://guides.starwarsfactfile.co.uk/droids-and-machines|text=Droids and Machines|work=[http://guides.starwarsfactfile.co.uk The Official Star Wars Fact File website]|archivedate=20140617132530}}</ref>
